candidates.name: slower-timescale directional persistence
candidates.mechanism: Gradual information incorporation and institutionally split order flow may create short-lived continuation.
candidates.falsifies: Non-positive forward gross expectancy or absent instrument/chronological breadth across both fixed horizons.
candidates.data: adjusted intraday OHLCV plus fixed context
candidates.relation_to_A_I: Directly tests whether weak five-minute follow-through reflects noisy sampling without assuming a fix.

candidates.name: volatility compression-expansion transition
candidates.mechanism: Positioning accumulated in quiet periods may drive price discovery during expansion.
candidates.falsifies: Frozen transitions lack positive broad gross expectancy.
candidates.relation_to_A_I: Could condition follow-through but resembles adaptive regime filtering.

candidates.name: cross-sectional relative strength
candidates.mechanism: Institutional rotation may preserve relative winner/loser ordering.
candidates.falsifies: Frozen ranks fail to predict later relative returns after costs.
candidates.relation_to_A_I: Escapes SBIN-only inference but changes the execution object.

selected.question: Does directional movement measured over a meaningful slower intraday interval across a preregistered universe of liquid NSE cash equities contain sufficiently persistent forward directional information to produce positive aggregate gross expectancy and survive realistic execution friction?
selected.rationale: Best combination of structural rationale, falsifiability, breadth, lower turnover, and low modeling freedom.

conditions.name: THIRTY_MINUTE
conditions.reason: Six five-minute bars materially reduce microstructure sensitivity while preserving intraday diffusion.

conditions.name: SIXTY_MINUTE
conditions.reason: A non-adjacent hourly condition tests materially greater aggregation.

timeframes.aggregation: 50% per condition, equal instrument weight within condition.
timeframes.multiplicity: Pooled metric and each condition must be positive; Holm correction across two formal condition tests.

universe.selection_date: last trading day immediately before Stage A
universe.rule: Point-in-time NIFTY 100; rank by trailing 60-session median traded value; require >=95% represented sessions over 252 scheduled sessions, >=252 sessions since listing, action history, and unambiguous identity; maximum four per selection-date sector.
universe.exclude: suspended, trade-to-trade, SME, price below INR20 at selection, ambiguous, materially incomplete, or unadjustable names
universe.shortfall: fewer than 20 blocks Phase 23 amendment before prices
universe.survivorship: point-in-time membership; retain later removals/delistings through valid history; no hindsight replacement
universe.actions: permanent IDs, dated symbol/token map, single frozen corporate-action policy; ambiguity fails closed
universe.SBIN: only if objectively selected; equal weight; exposed histories development/reference only; may not dominate
universe.identity_split: Before price acquisition sort permanent IDs by SHA256(protocol hash + ID); first 16 development-visible and last 8 withheld for N=24; otherwise at least 7 withheld and approximately one-third.

required: official selection-date NSE sector index per instrument
context.use: fixed context/diagnostics only; no post-result rescue filter or benchmark substitution

splits.anchor: latest completed regular NSE session available at acquisition, without inspecting prices
splits.A: earliest adjacent 12 calendar months; visible identities only; mechanics/debug/formulation freeze
splits.B: next 6 calendar months; sealed; all identities; exactly one canonical run after freeze
splits.C: next 6 calendar months; sealed; all identities; open only after unchanged B passes every gate; one run
splits.sample_minimum: TO BE FROZEN BEFORE DATA ACQUISITION from exchange calendar and design-based precision/power, never returns
splits.temporal: A-to-B and conditional B-to-C on unchanged identities
splits.cross_sectional: B reports visible and identity-withheld groups separately; withheld must pass gross/breadth gates

may_change: selection of one of two predefined structural formulations on A
development.budget: one mechanism; maximum two total operational formulations; every evaluated formulation consumes a slot; exhaustion requires a new cycle and fresh unexposed validation

economics.slippage: adverse 5 bps per leg, or larger justified from non-price metadata before acquisition; never reduced after results
economics.charges: complete prevailing NSE cash charges frozen before acquisition
economics.risk: 1% current realized capital per position; 2% aggregate open risk
economics.execution: completed signal bar, next physical eligible regular bar open; no backfill
economics.change_rule: timeframe-related change justified and frozen before held-out; never loosened

metrics.primary: equal-condition, equal-instrument mean gross expectancy per trade in initial-risk units, after modeled slippage and before explicit charges
metrics.no_drop: zero-trade instruments remain in breadth/accountability reporting

signal_edge: visible and withheld group gross expectancy >0
>=2 of 3 equal chronological blocks gross-positive; none >60% of positive gross P&L
no instrument >25% and no trade/session >10% of positive gross P&L
deployability: aggregate net P&L and equal-weight net expectancy >0
gross PF >=1.10 as prospective robustness margin
realized max drawdown <=20% as capital-preservation ceiling
slippage plus charges <=50% of pre-friction positive expectancy
stage_B_gates.decision: C only if every gate passes; gross failure rejects signal; gross pass/net failure rejects deployability

statistics.bootstrap: hierarchical moving-block bootstrap of contiguous trading-day blocks within instruments; block length frozen using A only; no IID trade bootstrap
statistics.aggregation: equal instrument weight and instrument-cluster robustness
statistics.formal: pooled hypothesis primary; Holm family-wise correction at two-sided alpha .05 across conditions

defects.before_held_out: stop; repair with synthetic/development evidence; preserve spec only if semantics unchanged; revalidate; keep sealed
defects.after_held_out: no silent patch/rerun; record contamination and assess interpretability; material change requires fresh unexposed data

stop_rules: Stage A broad gross edge absent
Stage B gross edge negative or gross subgroup gate fails

phase23.authorization: planning only; no automatic acquisition, strategy, or backtest authorization
phase23.objective: Offline acquisition-readiness specification: freeze independent point-in-time metadata sources, exchange calendar, design-based sample thresholds, manifests and sealing controls; require explicit approval before acquisition.
